name: Survey skiff
text: A Con-Reg survey skiff with a cracked drive housing, two surveyors in company orange asking for a tow to the lanes. They're very polite. They haven't checked your registration yet.

choices.label: Tow them to the lanes
choices.result: They sign for the tow on a company form, in triplicate. A good word goes up the line, for what that's worth at Con-Reg.

choices.label: Take their survey cores
choices.result: Survey cores sell well to the right broker, and you know three. The surveyors will file a complaint. Con-Reg reads every one.

choices.label: Keep flying
choices.result: The skiff's lights shrink behind you, blinking politely.
